Then quickly switch over to poultry!
The cooks are very tired from this work.
No smoke breaks, everyone stays in the kitchen!
You are too strict with our team.
I need you to work excellently!
The kitchen has run out of fresh arugula.
Lyova, quickly bring arugula from the storeroom!
I am a sous-chef, not a courier!
I decide myself who will go there!
Fine, Chef, I will bring this greenery.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.
In the kitchen they are preparing this order.

meanings.note: the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.trans: Fresh greens are placed on the plate.

meanings.note: verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?

examples.trans: I am a sous-chef, not a courier!
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
Where do you get your meat?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: остаётся у нас = stays with us

examples.trans: I know this town really well!
I love our town very much.
No smoke breaks in the kitchen!

перекурить.gloss: to smoke, have a smoke break

examples.trans: Can the cooks go out to smoke?

переходить.gloss: to cross, to move on to

meanings.en: to move on to, to switch to
meanings.note: от слов переходить к делу = move from words to action

examples.text: Он от слов переходит к делу.
examples.trans: He moves from words to action.
There are plenty of people there.
What did you bring into the flat?

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

meanings.en: to decide, to make up one's mind

examples.trans: Decide for yourselves what to do.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: Это старый заброшенный склад за городом.
examples.trans: It is an old abandoned warehouse outside town.

examples.text: У нас в школе очень строгий директор.
examples.trans: We have a very strict principal at our school.
They put bad meat in there for you.

meanings.note: сойти с ума = to go mad, lose one's mind

meanings.en: to get tired, to grow weary

examples.trans: I am very tired of sitting.
I'm calling to say thank you.
I'm sick of this communal flat.
